## 💸 Commission & Affiliate Payouts
**Sale → attributed and rated → refunds reversed → payout instruction.**

### Setup (about 16 minutes)
1. **⚙️ Config** → `partners` (id → name, email, rate), `minimumPayout`.
2. POST each sale:
   ```json
   { "orderId": "...", "partnerId": "...",
     "amount": 49, "currency": "USD" }
   ```
3. POST refunds the same way with `{"event":"refund", "orderId":"..."}`.
4. The schedule produces the payout run. Attach SMTP to the report.

### It does not move money — on purpose
It tells you exactly what to pay and to whom. **You** execute it through
your own provider. An automation with authority to send funds is a very
different risk class, and not one a template should assume.

### 🔄 Refunds must reverse commission
A commission earned on an order that is later refunded has to be clawed
back, or you are paying out on revenue **you no longer have**.

Most hand-rolled systems never do this, and the gap only becomes visible
when the numbers stop matching your bank.

Reversal here is automatic, and it works whether or not the original
earning has already been paid — an already-paid reversal becomes a
negative balance carried into the next run.

### 📌 The rate is frozen at sale time
If a partner's rate changes from 20% to 30%, **past sales keep 20%**.

Recalculating history is how commission disputes start — and the partner
always remembers the higher number.

Every earning stores the rate that applied when it was created.

### 🚫 Two safeguards on payout
**No double payment.** Every earning is stamped with a batch id when
paid. A re-run only ever considers unpaid records, so running the job
twice pays nobody twice.

**Minimum threshold.** Sending $0.40 costs more in fees than it
transfers. Balances below `minimumPayout` carry forward until they are
worth sending.

nodes.name: 🛒 Sale or refund
nodes.notes: POST {orderId, partnerId, amount} for sales, or {event:'refund', orderId} for reversals.

nodes.name: ⚙️ Config
nodes.notes: holdDays delays payout until the refund window has passed — pay too early and you claw back later.

nodes.name: 🛡️ Guard · validate + dedupe
nodes.notes: Validates required fields and drops duplicate deliveries. Safe to re-run.

nodes.name: 📒 Record the earning or reversal
nodes.notes: Append-only. Reversals are new negative records, never edits — that is what makes disputes answerable.

nodes.name: ↩️ 200 OK
nodes.notes: Answer fast so the provider does not retry on timeout.

nodes.name: ⚙️ Config (payout side)
nodes.notes: ⚠️ Mirror of the main Config. Change one, change both.

nodes.name: 🧮 Calculate what is owed
nodes.notes: Only unpaid, matured records count. Everything paid is stamped with the batch id, so re-runs are safe.

nodes.name: 📄 Build the payout instruction
nodes.notes: Unambiguous enough to act on without opening anything else.

nodes.name: 📨 Send the instruction
nodes.notes: Goes to you, not to partners. You execute the payments.

nodes.name: 🤫 Nothing due
nodes.notes: An empty run is logged, so you can tell 'nothing owed' from 'not running'.

nodes.name: 📒 Payout log
nodes.notes: ⚠️ Wire to a Sheet. This is the document that settles disputes.
